query: UPDATE managed_url SET path = COALESCE($2, path), url_type = COALESCE($3, url_type), deployment_id = CASE WHEN $3 IS NOT NULL THEN $4 ELSE deployment_id END, port = CASE WHEN $3 IS NOT NULL THEN $5 ELSE port END, url = CASE WHEN $3 IS NOT NULL THEN $6 ELSE url END, permanent_redirect = CASE WHEN $3 IS NOT NULL THEN $7 ELSE permanent_redirect END, http_only = CASE WHEN $3 IS NOT NULL THEN $8 ELSE http_only END WHERE id = $1;
